name: Produce Flame
summary: A cantrip that conjures a flame in your hand for light or to hurl for Fire damage.

stats.effect:
A flickering flame appears in your hand and remains there for the duration. While there, the flame emits no heat and ignites nothing, and it sheds {ref:glossary/bright-light} in a 20-foot radius and {ref:glossary/dim-light} for an additional 20 feet. The spell ends if you cast it again.

Until the spell ends, you can take a {ref:glossary/magic} action to hurl fire at a creature or an object within 60 feet of you. Make a ranged spell attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 Fire damage.
stats.cantripUpgrade: The damage increases by 1d8 when you reach levels 5 (2d8), 11 (3d8), and 17 (4d8).
